title: Physiology
description: An organ is cells in the thousands, and no cell is far from a vessel: the body is plumbing before anything else. Unlocks the Perfusion Rig.

puzzle.goal: A parent vessel of radius r splits into n daughters; Murray's law keeps the cubes adding up, so each daughter has the same radius. Write that radius R, as r over the cube root of n.
puzzle.name: Branching radius
puzzle.ask: Find R for r = @{r} and n = @{n}.
puzzle.method: Least work makes the cube of the parent radius equal the sum of the daughters' cubes: r^3 = n.R^3.
